changelog: Initial release: Complete Coda REST API v1 integration. Supports doc management (list, get, create, delete), tables, rows (CRUD), and pages. Features safety confirmations for destructive operations and JSON/Table/CSV output formats.
summary: General-purpose Coda document manager via REST API v1. Supports listing/creating/updating/deleting docs, managing tables/rows/pages, triggering automations, and exploring doc structure. Requires CODA_API_TOKEN environment variable. Delete operations require explicit confirmation; publishing and permission changes require explicit user intent.
